title: Votive torch
paint:
A pistol-sized flamer for one hand: a small lancet-windowed nozzle fed by a flask clipped under the grip. Pose: side profile turned slightly toward the viewer, nozzle to the right, level, about 80% of the canvas width like a pistol. Silhouette: a short brass nozzle shaped like a votive lamp, a round fuel flask under the frame, a coiled feed line, a small contained pilot flame at the tip. Materials: ivory-painted steel, gold bands, brass nozzle. Accent: Lumeri gold #F2C46A; the pilot flame small and contained.
At 32 px: a round flask under the grip and a lamp nozzle, no barrel.
